timeline.title: HDFC Bank fades despite new CEO clarity
timeline.line: RBI clears Anup Bagchi as MD & CEO; early 2% gain gave way to selling by late morning
more: Bagchi, now ICICI Prudential Life CEO, takes charge Oct 27 for three years
Q2 gross advances ~₹32.19 lakh cr, up about 16.3% YoY
Deposits ₹33.27 lakh cr, up 18.8% YoY; CASA up 10.8%
Stock hit ₹734 early (+2%) before slipping into the red

src.title: Upstox: HDFC Bank shares slip despite CEO clarity

timeline.title: HDFC Bank erases CEO-news gains
timeline.line: Shares fell as much as 2.8% to ₹701.25 after an early rise; among top Nifty drags
more: The fall came despite RBI clearing Anup Bagchi as MD & CEO
HCLTech and Asian Paints are also among the Nifty's top losers

src.title: Business Standard: Stock Market LIVE, Oct 5
